name: locationAutocomplete.text
title: Field: locationAutocomplete.text
description: Meaning and invariants of the session location autocomplete text field.
meaning: Free-form place or address text used to search, autocomplete, normalize, or translate a location.

invariants.label: minimum length
invariants.value: Text shorter than 3 characters returns an empty array.

invariants.label: intent
invariants.value: This is search text, not a stable location id.

text: Use this field for the user-provided place or address fragment. It can represent a city name, street, full address, or mixed free-form location text.
